name: Razorfen Downs
summary: Scourge power now stains Razorfen Downs, the quilboar’s sacred burial maze in southern Kalimdor. Their dead still rest among Agamaggan’s thorns, though necromancy has taken hold.

sections.title: A Sacred City Corrupted
sections.body: Razorfen Downs holds the quilboar’s ancestral dead among the petrified briars of Agamaggan. The thorn maze rises from the fallen demigod, and legend says its arched entrance was carved from the Great Boar’s own maw. For centuries, high priests of the Death's Head tribe tended its deep, winding burrows and honored the dead. Now a catastrophe darker than any quarrel over water in the Barrens has struck this sacred ground.

sections.title: The Scourge Reaches Kalimdor
sections.body: After the Third War, the Scourge reached southern Kalimdor in silence. Amnennar the Coldbringer, a frost-wielding lich, led agents of death into the thorn maze and turned the Death's Head priesthood from within. Now the quilboar harbor rotting ghouls, skeletons, and necromancers where they once honored their ancestors. Scourge power threatens to spread across the Barrens, and the quilboar’s holiest ground has become a base for its ambitions in the west.

faq.answer: Razorfen Downs holds the quilboar’s ancestral capital and burial grounds. Enormous thorn brambles grew from fallen Ancient Agamaggan, and the place remains the spiritual heart of quilboar culture. The Death's Head tribe’s high priesthood makes its headquarters here.

faq.q: Why is the Scourge inside Razorfen Downs?
aliases: why are there undead in razorfen downs
faq.answer: After the Third War, Amnennar the Coldbringer came to establish a Kalimdor stronghold for the Lich King. He corrupted the Death's Head priesthood and raised quilboar dead, turning the thorn maze into a hidden seat of necromantic power.

faq.q: How does Razorfen Downs differ from Razorfen Kraul?
faq.answer: Razorfen Kraul is the quilboar’s main military redoubt and living warren, ruled by the crone Charlga Razorflank. Razorfen Downs lies farther south as their traditional capital and sacred burial ground. Now the Scourge controls it, and necromancy holds sway.

aliases: how to get into razorfen downs
faq.answer: Razorfen Downs lies at the Barrens’ southern edge, overlooking the great drop into Thousand Needles. Its entrance is a natural arched fissure in the towering, tangled brambles. Legend says it was carved from Agamaggan’s gaping maw.

angles.text: The quilboar trouble the Crossroads, and a Lich King outpost at the Barrens’ edge threatens the Horde. You cannot afford to ignore it.
As Forsaken, you know the chill of finding a Scourge lich working in secret on Kalimdor. The master you rebelled against still commands such threats, and they must be destroyed swiftly.
